title: Visit Formats Payable from a Self-Pay Visit Package
content:
Not every visit format can be paid from every tier of the Self-Pay Visit Package, and extended or specialty visits draw more than one package visit on the smaller tiers. The chart shows each tier's coverage.

| Tier | Telehealth visits payable | Aquatic therapy visits payable | Specialty one-on-one visits payable | Package visits drawn by one extended 60-minute or specialty visit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter 4-Visit Package | Yes | No | No | 2 |
| Recovery 6-Visit Package | Yes | No | No | 2 |
| Core 8-Visit Package | Yes | Yes | No | 1 |
| Complete 12-Visit Package | Yes | Yes | Yes | 1 |
| Post-Surgical 18-Visit Package | No | Yes | No | 1 |
| Comprehensive 24-Visit Package | Yes | Yes | Yes | 1 |

**Questions the chart answers**

*Which tiers can pay for specialty one-on-one visits?* Only the Complete 12-Visit Package and the Comprehensive 24-Visit Package.

*Which tier cannot pay for telehealth visits?* The Post-Surgical 18-Visit Package; the other five tiers can.

*Which tiers can pay for aquatic therapy?* The Core 8-Visit, Complete 12-Visit, Post-Surgical 18-Visit and Comprehensive 24-Visit Packages; the Starter 4-Visit and Recovery 6-Visit Packages cannot.

*How many package visits does an extended 60-minute visit draw?* 2 on the Starter 4-Visit and Recovery 6-Visit Packages, and 1 on the other four tiers.
